mode.title: Organization Mode
mode.hint: Choose how SWAYA manages and renames files on your storage drives.
mode.registerHint: Indexes files and imports metadata to the database. Your files remain untouched on disk.
mode.inplaceHint: Renames files according to your template directly in their current folders.
mode.libraryHint: Renames and organizes files into clean folders inside your target library folder.

advanced.minVideoSizeMbHint: Video files smaller than this size are treated as extra clips instead of standalone movies.
advanced.minVideoDurationMinutesHint: Video files shorter than this are treated as extras.
advanced.tvMinVideoSizeMbHint: Episode files smaller than this size are treated as extras.
advanced.tvMinVideoDurationMinutesHint: Episode files shorter than this duration are treated as extras.

advancedLanguage.title: Metadata & Naming Language
advancedLanguage.metadataFollowsUi: Match metadata language with interface language
advancedLanguage.metadataFollowsUiHint: Attempts to fetch movie and series overviews in the same language as the app.
advancedLanguage.metadataLanguageHint: Primary language to request when fetching titles and plot summaries.
advancedLanguage.fallbackMetadataLanguageHint: Used when details are unavailable in your primary language.
advancedLanguage.targetFollowsUi: Use interface language for renamed filenames
advancedLanguage.targetFollowsUiHint: Formats renamed files and folders using the application language.
advancedLanguage.targetLanguageHint: The language used when generating renamed filenames and folders.

closeBehavior.title: Window Close Action

closeBehavior.hint: Choose what happens when clicking the window close button.

language.title: Language

adult.title: Adult Content
adult.includeAdultHint: Allows searching and organizing adult scenes, adult stars, and studios. Adds a flame switch to the title bar for instant mode toggling.
adult.adultGenderPreferenceHint: Filter adult star catalogs by gender preference (All, Female, Male).
adult.customTargetFolderHint: Dedicated target folder for adult media assets. If left empty, the main library folder is used.

adultSafety.blacklistHint: Items matching any of these tags or title keywords will be completely excluded from scans.

folders.title: Storage Folders
folders.scanFolderPlaceholder: Folder where unorganized media is stored
folders.targetFolderPlaceholder: Folder where organized files will be placed

organization.title: Organization Presets
organization.presetHint: Choose a library layout style compatible with your preferred media player.
organization.customToggleHint: Enable to fine-tune subfolder templates and filename formatting tags.

presets.plexDesc: Plex-compatible structure with dedicated subfolders and extras grouped under Extras/.
presets.jellyfinDesc: Jellyfin-friendly structure keeping subtitles and extras directly alongside the main video.
presets.kodiDesc: Kodi-compatible layout with dot-separated filenames and local extras.
presets.minimalDesc: Flat folder hierarchy with minimal subfolder nesting.

organization.previewHint: Live preview of how files and folders will be organized.

fileNaming.title: Filename Templates
fileNaming.casingHint: Letter casing style applied to generated filenames.
fileNaming.separatorHint: Character used between words in generated filenames.
fileNaming.movieTemplateHint: Template for movies. Available tags: {title}, {year}, {resolution}, {edition}, and {custom}.
fileNaming.episodeTemplateHint: Template for episodes. Available tags: {tv_title}, {season}, {episode}, {episode_title}, {resolution}, and {custom}.
fileNaming.customTagHint: Text inserted wherever the {custom} placeholder is used in naming patterns.
fileNaming.videoExtsHint: Comma-separated list of file extensions recognized as video media.

scenes.minVideoSizeMbHint: Smaller files are treated as extras. A 1 MB cutoff preserves short social clips.
scenes.minVideoDurationMinutesHint: Shorter video files are treated as extra clips. A 1-minute minimum filters out preview clips.
scenes.fansdbMinVideoDurationMinutesHint: Minimum duration for FansDB indie clip scans.
scenes.filenameTemplateHint: Choose which metadata fields are included in renamed scene files.
scenes.dateFormatHint: Formatting applied to the {date} tag in templates.
scenes.preventTitlePerformer: Strip repeated adult star names from title start
scenes.preventTitlePerformerHint: Cleans redundant prefixes (e.g. 'Jane Doe - Jane Doe Audition' becomes 'Jane Doe - Audition').
scenes.groupingModeHint: Organizes scenes into studio subfolders inside your library folder.
scenes.folderTemplateHint: Preview of the subfolder naming structure inside your target library folder.
scenes.createSceneSubdirHint: Places each scene inside its own subfolder.
scenes.tagLimitHint: Set to 0 to omit tags from filenames. Higher numbers include up to that many tags.
scenes.tagSeparatorHint: Delimiter used between tags in the {tags} placeholder.
scenes.tagBlacklistHint: Comma-separated tag names that should never appear in generated filenames.
scenes.performerLimitHint: Maximum number of adult star names to include in the filename.
scenes.keepPerformersAtLimit: Keep only the first adult stars up to the limit
scenes.performerSortHint: Determines the sequence of adult star names in filenames.
scenes.squeezeStudioNames: Remove spaces from studio names in filenames

folderStructure.orgEnabledHint: When disabled, files are renamed in place without creating subfolders.
folderStructure.moveToLibrary: Move files to target library folder
folderStructure.moveToLibraryHint: When enabled, files are moved into your target library directory. When disabled, files stay in the source folder.
folderStructure.sortByType: Separate movies and TV shows into dedicated root folders
folderStructure.sortByTypeHint: Creates separate top-level folders for Movies, TV Shows, and Adult content.
folderStructure.organizeAdultByType: Separate adult movies, shows, and scenes
folderStructure.organizeAdultByTypeHint: Creates dedicated subfolders inside the adult library directory.
folderStructure.removeEmptyHint: Automatically cleans up leftover empty directories after files are organized.
folderStructure.createMovieSubdirHint: Places each movie in its own subfolder.
folderStructure.createVideoSubdirHint: Places each video file in its own subfolder.
folderStructure.createShowDirHint: Places each TV show in its own folder.
folderStructure.createSeasonDirHint: Groups episodes into Season XX subfolders.
folderStructure.createEpisodeDirHint: Places each episode in its own subfolder (useful when storing local extras per episode).
folderStructure.impactHint: Live preview of how your folder structure settings organize your media library.

rules.collisionStrategy: When a destination file already exists

collections.createCollectionDirHint: Groups related movies (e.g. franchises, trilogies) into shared collection folders.
collections.collectionThresholdHint: Only creates a collection folder if you own at least this many movies in the franchise.

extras.title: Extras & Subtitles
extras.extrasEnabledHint: Detects and organizes subtitles, trailers, featurettes, and artwork.
extras.folderModeHint: Choose whether extras are stored in a dedicated subfolder or alongside the main video file.
extras.inplaceInfo: In rename in-place mode, extras remain alongside the main video file.
extras.inPlaceInfo: In rename in-place mode, extras remain alongside the main video file.
extras.libraryInfo: When organizing into your library folder, extras and subtitles are moved alongside the main video.
extras.registerInfo: In register mode, extra files are indexed in the database without being moved or renamed.

resetDefaults.title: Reset to Defaults
resetDefaults.description: Resets all naming templates, player preferences, and app options to system default values. Your media library database and physical files will not be touched.
resetDefaults.confirmDescription: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to defaults? Your current unsaved and custom configurations will be replaced with initial default values.
resetDefaults.success: Settings reset to defaults. Click Save Changes to apply.

liveImpact.fileNamingHint: Preview of how your naming patterns format movie and episode filenames.
liveImpact.folderStructureHint: Preview of how your folder settings structure the library directory.

torrent.title: Download Integration
torrent.hint: Integrates Jackett and qBittorrent to search and download titles directly from the app.
torrent.qbUrlPlaceholder: Directory where completed downloads will be saved...
torrent.qbHelpText:
To configure qBittorrent:
1. Open qBittorrent.
2. Go to Tools -> Options -> Web UI.
3. Enable the Web User Interface.
4. Set your port (default: 8080), username, and password.
5. Enter those values in the fields above.
torrent.jackettInfo: Jackett runs in the background. Use the link below to configure your indexers.

dangerZone.title: Database Reset
dangerZone.desc: Clears all indexed libraries, matches, custom lists, and watch history from the database. Your settings and API keys are preserved. This action cannot be undone.
dangerZone.confirm: Are you sure? This will clear all libraries, matches, lists, and playback history. Your settings and API keys will remain. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.wipeCacheDesc: Clears cached online metadata, posters, and summaries, resetting items to review needed. Your media files on disk and manual overrides remain intact.
dangerZone.confirmWipeCache: Are you sure you want to clear the scraped metadata cache? This resets online matches to review needed while preserving your media files and manual overrides.
